newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Chevron says Nigeria gas project completed.
newsitem.headline: Chevron says Nigeria gas project completed.

text.p: Chevron Nigeria's Escravos gas gathering project has been completed and would take off on Thursday, the News Agency of Nigeria reported on Monday.
"The start up date of the project remains May 1," Chevron spokesman Tunde Ilevbare was quoted as telling a correspondent of the state agency in Lagos.

The $559 million gas project, a joint-venture between Chevron and state-owned Nigeria National Petroleum Corp (NNPC), involves gathering 165 million cubic feet of gas daily, now being flared at Escravos, near the mid-western Warri.
Warri has been hit in the past one month by communal clashes involving youths of rival ethnic groups feuding over the relocation of the municipal council headquarters.
Chevron says its own operations have not been affected by the the clashes.
"The gas project will start as scheduled," the Chevron spokesman said.
